name: EmBRACE — CompanyWall Harvest (banded search → Google Sheets)

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit by hand before each run. One county + one size per run.

parameters.content:
## 1. Configure this run
Edit **Config** by hand. One county + one size per run.

| code | county | | code | county |
| ---: | --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| 1 | Zagrebačka | | 12 | Brodsko-posavska |
| 3 | Sisačko-moslavačka | | 13 | Zadarska |
| 4 | Karlovačka | | 15 | Šibensko-kninska |
| 7 | Bjelovarsko-bilogorska | | 16 | Vukovarsko-srijemska |
| 9 | Ličko-senjska | | 17 | Splitsko-dalmatinska |
| 11 | Požeško-slavonska | | 19 | Dubrovačko-neretvanska |

**Micro** = 1–10 employees, 0–2,000,000 EUR
**Malo** = 11–49 employees, 2,000,000–10,000,000 EUR


**revenue_bands** — starting bands, comma separated. Any that returns 60 is split automatically.

Micro: `0-100000, 100000-400000, 400000-1000000, 1000000-2000000`
Malo: `2000000-3000000, 3000000-5000000, 5000000-7500000, 7500000-10000000`

Bands must **share endpoints**. A gap loses every company inside it — the run logs a `!! GAP` warning if it finds one.

`enrich_profiles: false` → harvest only (fast). Fill columns I–M later with the **enrich** workflow.
`test_mode: true` → stop after 2 revenue bands.

## 2. Adaptive revenue banding
CompanyWall caps anonymous search at **~60 results (3 × 20) per query** and shows no total count.

So a band returning 60 is **truncated, not complete**. `Band Done` bisects it and queues both halves; a band under 60 is genuinely finished.

This is what reaches companies past the 60th without a login.

## 3. Optional enrichment
`enrich_profiles = false` skips the profile call entirely — no wait, no request. Columns I–M stay blank and the row is still written.

Profile HTML is parsed by Croatian label text in `Add Profile Fields`. If a column is blank, the log prints a `PROFILE PAGE TEXT SAMPLE` with the real labels — add them to the `LABELS` map there.

## 4. Dedupe + write
Looks up **OIB** in `Raw Leads`. Present → skip. Absent → append one row.

Bands overlap by design; dedup is what makes that safe.

Employees/Revenue are written as raw Croatian text (`cellFormat: RAW`).

The append maps **by header name**, so row 1 of `Raw Leads` must read exactly:
`Name | Profile URL | Status | OIB | Employees | Revenue | County | Size Category | Owner/Director | Email | Founding Date | NKD Code | MBS`
